meta.title: Tasuddemt n tedyanin n Qarṭaǧ — sebɛa iqrunen n umezruy
meta.desc: Seg users sɣur Elisa deg 814 send Ɛisa armi d uṭṭef sɣur Ṛuma deg 146 : izemzan imeqqranen n Qarṭaǧ, seg lxiwanat ifiniqiyen armi d imenɣan ipunikiyen.
hero.title: Sebɛa iqrunen n umezruy
hero.lede: Seg users afiniqi armi d uṭṭef sɣur Ṛuma : izemzan imeqqranen n Qarṭaǧ, zzman s zzman.
frieze.title: Lawanat imeqqranen
frieze.note: Tehri n yal lawan temsaɛdal akked tallit-is
frieze.periods.0.name: Lawan aqdim
frieze.periods.0.desc: Asers d tmɣuṛt n temdint. Qarṭaǧ tɛedda seg uxxam n ttjara afiniqi amecṭuḥ ɣer tezmert tagejdant n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi, ɣer tama n uzeṭṭa ameqqran n tnazduɣin akked yixxamen n ttjara.
frieze.periods.1.name: Lawan n ddheb
frieze.periods.1.desc: Zzman ameqqran n tezmert taqarṭaǧit : amagnu n lebḥer, imenɣan mgal Igrikiyen n Sicile, tafellaḥt yesɛan tamusni akked ttjara ɣer ddunit meṛṛa.
frieze.periods.2.name: Imenɣan ipunikiyen
frieze.periods.2.desc: Amennuɣ ameqqran akked Ṛuma ɣef lḥekma n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan, yettwacarḍen s wayen i yexdem Hanibal Barka di Italya.
frieze.periods.3.name: Aṭṭef & tikemmilt
frieze.periods.3.desc: Mbeɛd Zama, Qarṭaǧ tesɛa talalit tamaynut tadamsant yelhan aṭas. Deg 146, Ṛuma teṭṭef tamdint s telqey ; maca idles, tutlayt d wegdud apunik qqimen ddren.
list.title: Izemzan imeqqranen
eras.0.name: Asers & tanejma
eras.0.desc: Seg tanazduɣt n Ṣur ɣer tezmert tamezwarut n lebḥer deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi.
eras.1.name: Imenɣan ipunikiyen
eras.1.desc: Sețța iɣerdayen n umenɣi mgal Ṛuma, seg Sicile armi d Zama, s yisali n Hanibal di Italya.
eras.2.name: Aɣelli
eras.2.desc: Talwit n win yettwanyifen, talalit tadamsant, syen amennuɣ wis krad akked uṭṭef n temdint.
events.0.title: Asers n Qarṭaǧ
events.0.text: Tagellidt tafiniqit Didun (Elisa), i yerwlen seg Ṣur mbeɛd wenɣi n wergaz-is Acherbas sɣur gma-s Pygmalion, tesres Qarṭaǧ — Qart-Ḥadašt, « Tamdint tamaynut » — ɣef rrif n Tunisia n wassa. Tiɣilt n Byrsa tuɣal d ul n temdint. Azemz-agi yekka-d seg umesnezruy agrikan Timée ; idlal iqdimen akteṛ i yettwakecfen swayen seg tama tis sin n lqern wis 8 send Ɛisa.
events.1.title: Tanejma deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan
events.1.text: Qarṥaǧ tesres lxiwanat di Sardaigne, deg umalu n Sicile, di Jzayer Baléares — Ibiza (Ebusus) tettwasers azal n 654 akken i d-yeqqar Diodore — akked ɣer rrif n Tafrikt n ugafa. Tuɣal d tezmert tafiniqit tagejdant n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi.
events.2.title: Amenɣi n Alalia
events.2.text: Dduklen akked Yitruskiyen, Iqarṭaǧiyen nnuɣen ɣef lebḥer n Corse akked Igrikiyen n Phocée. Akken i d-yeqqar Hérodote, Iphocéens nɣelben maca xesren 40 seg 60 n lbabura-nsen ǧǧan tigzirt : tanyafit tsertant i Qarṭaǧ, tesḥebbes tanejma tagrikit deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi.
events.3.title: Amtawa amezwaru akked Ṛuma
events.3.text: Akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, amtawa-agi n ttjara d uɛerraq ibedd s yimukan n lḥekma : lbabura iṛumaniyen ur zemren ara ad aɛḏun « Ucenfiṛ Ihlan », qrib Qarṭaǧ. Tagduda tamaynut tqebbel lḥekma n lebḥer tapunikt.
events.4.title: Amenɣi n Himère
events.4.text: Di Sicile, Hamilkar Umagoni yettwanɣi sɣur Gélon n Syracuse akked Théron n Agrigente. Aɣelli-agi yeḥbes deg waṭas n iseggasen tanejma taqarṭaǧit deg tegzirt, yesseɣli-d ismenyafen tisertiyin di Qarṭaǧ.
events.5.title: Tiklariyin n Hanun d Himilcon
events.5.text: Hanun yeddu ɣef rrif n ugaraw n Tafrikt s lebḥer n imaẓlaḥ ; Himilcon yali ɣer rrif n ugaraw n Turuft. Taqsist n Hanun, yettwasuɣlen ɣer tegrikit, tewweḍ-aɣ-d.
events.6.title: Qarṭaǧ teḍfeṛ ɣer Tafrikt
events.6.text: Akken i d-yeqqar Justin, Qarṭaǧ tettaɣ seg users-is ssuma n useggas i Yifrikiyen ɣef lqaɛa n temdint ; ddaw n Imagoniden, teḥbes lxellaṣ tṭṭef akal-is s leslaḥ. Ttwalin deg-s lmeɛna n Himère ; kra n yimesnezruyen smenyafen ad d-inin d amɣiwan bessif.
events.7.title: Tuɣalin ɣer Sicile
events.7.text: Hanibal, mmi-s n mmi-s n Hamilkar, yehdem Sélinonte akked Himère (409). Yemmut s ṭṭaɛun zdat Agrigente, i yeṭṭef win i t-id-yeqbalen Himilcon (406). Talwit yettwagren akked Denys n Syracuse (405) d asteɛfu kan.
events.8.title: Denys n Syracuse mgal Qarṭaǧ
events.8.text: Denys yeṭṭef Motyé, lqelɛa tapunit n ugmur n Sicile. Tiririt tapunit tewweḍ ɣer uḥeṛṣ n Syracuse, yettwakkes deg 396 ɣef ddemma n ṭṭaɛun. Amenɣi yuɣal yettḍerri deg sețța iseggasen.
events.9.title: Amtawa wis sin akked Ṛuma
events.9.text: Akken i d-yeqqar Polybe (III, 24), yesmɣuṛ amḍiq ittwagdlen ɣef Iṛumaniyen armi d Mastia, di Hispanya, isekkeṛ-asen Sardaigne akked Libya.
events.10.title: Agathocle yekcem Tafrikt
events.10.text: Ameɣbun n Syracuse yers ɣer Ras Addar, yettḥuddu Qarṭaǧ s telqey. Ittwarra-d ɣer deffir (307), maca teklal-agi tesken-d ddheṣṣa n tmurt tafrikant n temdint.
events.11.title: « Amtawa n Philinos »
events.11.text: Akken i d-yeqqar umesnezruy Philinos n Agrigente, Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ gedlent iman-nsent, yiwet Sicile, tayeḍ Italya. Polybe yenkar belli amtawa-agi yella ; Tite-Live yeqqar-d tuɣalin n lemɛahda deg useggas-agi. Tamsalt tettwamseyya ar ass-a.
events.12.title: Timsalt mgal Pyrrhus
events.12.text: Ṛuma akked Qarṭaǧ gallant ad ɛawant yiwet tayeḍ mgal Pyrrhus, agellid n Épire (Polybe, III, 25). D amtawa-nsent aneggaru send umenɣi.
events.13.title: Pyrrhus di Sicile
events.13.text: Yettusawel sɣur Igrikiyen n Sicile, Pyrrhus yeṭṭef qrib akk amalu apunik, maca yerreẓ zdat Lilybée yeffeɣ tigzirt. Akken i d-yeqqar Plutarque, yettwali deg-s yakan amḍiq n umenɣi n Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ.
events.14.title: Amenɣi apunik amezwaru
events.14.text: Amennuɣ ameqqran amezwaru gar Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ, ɣef Sicile. Mbeɛd 23 iseggasen n umenɣi n lebḥer d wakal, yefra s uɣelli n Tegzirin n Égates (241), Qarṭaǧ texsar Sicile ; Ṛuma tuɣal d tezmert n lebḥer.
events.15.title: Amennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen
events.15.text: Iɛeskriyen ur ittwaxelṣen ara kkren-d, dduklen-d yid-sen amur n Ilibikiyen. Hamilkar Barka yeḥṛes-iten mbeɛd umenɣi aqsiḥ, i yesbedden tazmert n twacult n Barka. Ṛuma teṭṭef ɣef teklal-agi iwakken ad teṭṭef Sardaigne akked Corse.
events.16.title: Hamilkar yettaɛ Hispanya
events.16.text: Iwakken ad yerr lexsas, Hamilkar Barka yeddu ad yettaɛ tigzirt n Hispanya, tarikt deg nnuqra, yesres Akra Leukè. Mmi-s Hanibal, 9 iseggasen, yedda yid-s mbeɛd ma yegall zdat umnar ur ad yili d amddakel n Ṛuma.
events.17.title: Hanibal yeṭṭef lqiyada
events.17.text: Mbeɛd wenɣi n Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ — argaz n yelli-s n Hamilkar akked umesles n Carthagène —, lɛesker n Hispanya ssawlen i Hanibal Barka, 26 iseggasen, d anezwi ameqqran.
events.18.title: Aḥeṛṣ n Sagonte
events.18.text: Hanibal yeḥreṣ yeṭṭef, mbeɛd ṭsam wagguren, Sagonte, tamdint tiberiyen tamddakelt n Ṛuma. Teklal-agi tesnulfa amenɣi apunik wis sin, ameqqran akteṛ deg umezruy aqdim.
events.19.title: Tizgart n Idurar n Alpes
events.19.text: Hanibal yeffeɣ Hispanya s 50 000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar, 9 000 n yineggafen akked 37 n ilfan, yezger Idurar n Pyrénées, yezger unzul n Gaule syen Idurar n Alpes deg 15 wussan. Akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, ur yewweḍ ara ɣer Italya ala s 20 000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar akked 6 000 n yineggafen.
events.19.alt: Leutemann — Hanibal yezger Idurar n Alpes
events.20.title: Tessin d Trébie
events.20.text: Tinyafiyin tiamezwura di Italya. Deg Tessin, ineggafen n Hanibal nɣelben wid n ukunsul Scipion. Deg Trébie, tuffra i d-yesnulfa Magun, gma-s n Hanibal, teṭṭef lɛesker n Sempronius Longus seg deffir.
events.21.title: Ilel n Trasimène
events.21.text: Yiwet seg tuffuriyin timeqqranin n umezruy aɛesskari : Hanibal yesselkam lɛesker n ukunsul Flaminius ɣer rrif n ilel, deg usigna. 15 000 n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan, ula d ukunsul s yiman-is. Ṛuma tella deg tugdi tameqqrant.
events.22.title: Amenɣi n Cannes
events.22.text: S lɛesker idrus ɣef win n Ṛuma, Hanibal yezzi yehlek 8 llejyunat tiṛumaniyin (azal n 50 000 ɣer 70 000 n lmut). Azzel-agi s snat tama-s mazal-it yettwaɣren deg tesdawiyin tipesskariyin.
events.22.alt: Tamettant n Paul Émile di Cannes
events.23.title: Hasdrubal deg Métaure
events.23.text: Hasdrubal Barka yezger daɣen Idurar n Alpes iwakken ad yaweḍ ɣer gma-s s tallalt n Hispanya. Yettwaṭṭef deg Métaure, yettwanɣa ; Iṛumaniyen gren aqerru-s deg uɛessas n Hanibal.
events.24.title: Asawel n Hanibal
events.24.text: Scipion yers ɣer Tafrikt (204). Syphax, agellid anumidi amddakel n Qarṭaǧ, yettwaṭṭef ; tameṭṭut-is Sofonisba textar times ɣef ma tettunefk i Ṛuma. Magun Barka yemmut s lǥerḥ-is mi d-yuɣal seg Italya, Hanibal yettusawel mbeɛd xemsṭaεac iseggasen n umenɣi.
events.25.title: Amenɣi n Zama
events.25.text: Scipion, yeddukel akked Unumidi Masinisa, yennuɣ akked Hanibal qrib Zama. Tirrategin n Hanibal ttwarran-d fell-as : Qarṭaǧ texsar amenɣi tettwaḥettem ad teqbel tiwtilin n talwit yessukksen.
events.25.alt: Amenɣi n Zama, tugna n Cornelis Cort
events.26.title: Talwit n win yettwanyifen
events.26.text: Qarṭaǧ tettuḥettem ad texles 10 000 n ttalan deg 50 n iseggasen, ad tefk ilfan-is, ad tessemẓi lebḥer-is ɣer mraw n lbabura, akked ur tettnaɣ ara war laṣel n Ṛuma.
events.27.title: Hanibal d asufet
events.27.text: Yettwafren d asufet, Hanibal yeṣṣeḥḥa idrimen n temdint, yeg lameṛ n yimḥekmen n Tegrawt n Meɛa-ṛebɛa ad yettwaǧdeḏ aseggas s aseggas. Temdint tesɛa talalit tadamsant yelhan aṭas. Yettwamle i Ṛuma sɣur yiɛdawen-is, ittuḥettem ad yeffeɣ ɣer Ccerq (195).
events.28.title: Tamettant n Hanibal
events.28.text: Yezdeɣ ɣer igelliden ihelenistiyen, yettwaḥuddu sɣur Ṛuma, Hanibal yesserɣ iman-is deg Libyssa, di Bithynie, iwakken ur ittunefk ara.
events.29.title: Lexlaṣ aneggaru
events.29.text: Qarṭaǧ tfukk axleṣ n lxedima n umenɣi-ines teṭṭef leslaḥ mgal tikcumin n Masinisa. Di Ṛuma, anida Caton yettales « Carthago delenda est », ttwalin deg-s arrez n lemɛahda.
events.30.title: Amenɣi apunik wis krad
events.30.text: Qarṭaǧ tefka leslaḥ-is, syen Ṛuma tessuter i yimezdaɣ-is ad ǧǧen tamdint ad zedɣen ɣer lebɛid n lebḥer. Ugin : iteddu uḥeṛṣ n krad iseggasen, armi d ukeččum n Scipion Émilien ɣer temdint.
events.31.title: Aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ
events.31.text: Deg tafsut, Scipion Émilien yerẓ leḥras ; sețța wussan n umenɣi deg iberdan wwḍen armi d Byrsa. Tamdint tettwasserɣ, wid i d-yeqqimen ttwazenzen d aklan, tamurt tuɣal d tamnaḏt taṛumanit n Tafrikt.
events.31.note: Tamawt tasenfarrutant — Ikecfan n Byrsa sbeggnen-d taglift n times n 146, ddaw-as ixxamen ipuniyen țwaḥerzen. Lmelḥ i yeẓẓan ɣef lxrab d tamacahut tatrart ; Ṛuma tesres daɣen Qarṭaǧ deg umḍiq-nni lqern mbeɛd.
after.title: Tamdint tettlal-d tikkelt-nniḍen
after.rows.0.val: Caius Gracchus yeεreḍ ad yesres deg umḍiq-agi tanazduɣt taṛumanit n Junonia : lmeqsud yerreẓ.
after.rows.1.val: Yettwaḥudd sɣur César, asers-nni-nniḍen yettwakemmel ddaw n Auguste : Colonia Iulia Concordia Carthago tuɣal d tamanaḏt n Tafrikt taṛumanit.
after.rows.2.val: Augustin yeqqar-d belli tapunikt mazal-itt yettwamsel deg tuddar n Tafrikt.
after.rows.3.val: Amḍiq asenfarrutan n Qarṭaǧ yettwajerred deg lwert agraɣlan n UNESCO.
after.d2: Qrib akk izemzan-agi d-kkan seg yimeskaren igrikiyen akked iṛumaniyen — Polybe, Tite-Live, Appien. Tasenfarrut tezmer ass-a ad ten-temsefham akked igr i ǧǧan Iqarṭaǧiyen s yiman-nsen.
